senses.gloss: स्तेम स्तेम. See under rt. स्तिम्.

स्तेन् स्तेन् (more properly regarded as a
Nom. fr. स्तेन below; cf. rt. स्तै), cl. 10.
P. स्तेनयति, अतिस्तेनत्, &c., to steal, rob; [cf. Gr.
στερέω; Goth. stil-an, ‘to steal;’ Angl. Sax. stelan,
stal, stalian, stalu.]

स्तेन, अस्, m. (perhaps to be connected with a
form स्ते derived fr. स्ति for rt. स्तै; cf. स्त्येन fr.
rt. स्त्यै), a thief, robber; (अम्), n. thieving, steal-
ing.
—स्तेन-निग्रह, अस्, m. the restraining or
punishing of thieves; suppression of theft.

स्तेय, अम्, n. [cf. rt. स्तै], theft, robbery; any-
thing stolen or liable to be stolen; anything clandes-
tine or private.
—स्तेय-कृत्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. one who
commits a theft, a thief, robber.
स्तेयिन्, ई, m. a thief, robber; a goldsmith.

स्तेप् स्तेप्, cl. 1. A. स्तेपते, &c., to ooze,
&c. (= rt. स्तिप्, q. v.); cl. 10. P. स्तेप-
यति, &c., to send, throw.
